006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
010
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Objects;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
016
017/**
018 * Represents an immutable execution context for function calls in Metapath
019 * expressions.
020 * <p>
021 * This class is designed to support both named and anonymous functions by
022 * maintaining the function instance, its arguments, and the current context
023 * item. It ensures thread-safety through immutability and is primarily used
024 * during the evaluation of Metapath expressions and for caching the function
025 * results.
026 */
027public final class CalledContext {
028  @NonNull
029  private final IFunction function;
030  @Nullable
031  private final IItem contextItem;
032  @NonNull
033  private final List<ISequence<?>> arguments;
034
035  /**
036   * Creates an immutable execution context for a function call.
037   *
038   * @param function
039   *          the function to be executed
040   * @param arguments
041   *          the list of evaluated arguments as sequences, must match function's
042   *          arity
043   * @param contextItem
044   *          the optional context item representing the current node in scope
045   */
046  public CalledContext(
047      @NonNull IFunction function,
048      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
049      @Nullable IItem contextItem) {
050    this.function = function;
051    this.contextItem = contextItem;
052    this.arguments = arguments;
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Get the function instance associated with the calling context.
057   *
058   * @return the function instance
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  public IFunction getFunction() {
062    return function;
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Get the node item focus associated with the calling context.
067   *
068   * @return the context item, or null if no context is set
069   */
070  @Nullable
071  public IItem getContextItem() {
072    return contextItem;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get the arguments associated with the calling context.
077   *
078   * @return the arguments
079   */
080  @NonNull
081  public List<ISequence<?>> getArguments() {
082    return arguments;
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  public int hashCode() {
087    final int prime = 31;
088    int result = 1;
089    result = prime * result + getFunction().hashCode();
090    return prime * result + Objects.hash(contextItem, arguments);
091  }
092
093  @Override
094  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
095    if (this == obj) {
096      return true;
097    }
098    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
099      return false;
100    }
101    CalledContext other = (CalledContext) obj;
102    if (!getFunction().equals(other.getFunction())) {
103      return false;
104    }
105    return Objects.equals(function, other.function)
106        && Objects.equals(arguments, other.arguments)
107        && Objects.equals(contextItem, other.contextItem);
108  }
109}
